unit.why: A deathbed narrative of a tzaddik on Hoshana Rabba 5664: he dons white garments, blesses his only son and successor, recites Nishmat and dies in devekut.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with a section heading for the omissions to ספר עשר קדושות (paratext), which belongs with the next division.

stories.start_quote: בך יברך ישראל מסדר פטירתו נפלאות
stories.summary_en: On the night of Hoshana Rabba 5664 the tzaddik dressed in new white garments and blessed his only son and successor, telling him to come with all Jews to the Land of Israel. He then began reciting Nishmat and died in a state of devekut.

tags.why: The whole text narrates the tzaddik's passing.
